records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE production sprite atlas for a layered 2D chibi paper-doll game on genuine transparent RGBA background. Image 1 is STYLE reference, match polished rounded 2-head-tall proportions, large shiny eyes, clean outlines and soft cel shading. Image 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Image 3 is the exact ATLAS STRUCTURE reference only, do not copy its identity. Preserve target hair, eyes, costume and accessories simplified for a 108px game sprite. Strict layout square atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 16 isolated cutouts each centered within its cell, with 8 percent empty transparent margin on every cell side, no crossing boundaries. No labels, text, grid lines, shadows, backgrounds or watermark. Row 1: four same-size registered front-view HEADS (head, short framing hair, ears and hat ONLY, no shoulders or long rear hair): neutral smile, happy open-mouth, surprised O-mouth, sleepy closed-eyes. Identical face shape and accessory placement. Row 2: (1) complete clothed torso with short flared skirt, neck but NO head, arms, hands, legs or shoes; concealed shoulders fully painted; (2) screen-left relaxed full arm with sleeve and hand, shoulder upper-right; (3) screen-right relaxed full arm, shoulder upper-left; (4) screen-left short leg and shoe. Row 3: (1) screen-right short leg and shoe; (2) screen-left bent full arm holding pencil pointing down toward desk; (3) screen-right bent full arm resting hand on desk; (4) screen-left bent full arm holding a small rice bowl near chest, only ONE hand. Row 4: (1) screen-right bent full arm raising a spoon toward mouth, only ONE hand; (2) FULL BODY seated resting chibi with knees bent, hands on lap, closed eyes, same outfit, real seated pose, no cushion; (3) separate rear hair mass with hidden center fully painted, NO face/body/ears/hat, flowing behind head to skirt; (4) separate character-specific tail or rear ornament. Sleeves include shoulder overlap. All 16 sprites orthographic front-facing and consistent lighting. Use highest useful square resolution. Character identity: Violet hair fading cyan, purple eyes, ONE high side ponytail on screen-right with turquoise circular loop hair tie. White violet cyan futuristic idol jacket, asymmetric white pleated skirt with cyan inserts and purple belt, covered midriff for chibi design, mismatched purple/white socks and white chunky sneakers. NO extra doll, no second person, no floating magical object. Last cell is a separate violet/cyan long waist ribbon with small plain ID badge.
